Sandbach United v  New Mills

Underway here at Hind Heath Road, let’s got The Bach!
Not been this green for a while https://t.co/yhci4SVHBf

🔵⚪️ v  🟢🟢

Sandbach United v  New Mills

The Bach field an unchanged side as they look to secure a second home win on the bounce in 4 days. It certainly will be a tough test but the boys will be fired up after their important narrow win over Stafford on Saturday.
The line up remains unchanged from Saturdays win over Stafford Town for this tough test in rather arid conditions. https://t.co/z8KwYQOcvz

7.45pm kick off tonight, it’s a lovely evening, bar open and a cracking game in prospect - we look forward to seeing you later! 

Adults £6, Concessions £5,  U16 £2 https://t.co/OgycBDEODl

7.45pm kick off Tuesday at Hind Heath Road, The Bach take on New Mills @NewMillsFC

This is likely to be a cracker between two teams who have battled it out at in  or around the top 6 in recent seasons. Come down and enjoy some local football.

Adults £6, Concessions £5, U16 £2
Congratulations to our very own @cain_harry who became only the 14th player in our history to clock up 100 competitive games at Sandbach United! Here’s to the next 100 Harry!! https://t.co/vqsGCJ8xYd

The games are coming thick and fast as we have our 4th League game and 3rd at home in 11 days as The Bach entertain New Mills, 7.45pm kick off at Hind Heath Road. Always an intense fixture and with both teams on 6pts it’s sure to be a close affair.  Come down and support The Bach https://t.co/CV8VgzNjVa

Another player has been sponsored and this time it’s match winner @Stantat10 sponsored by @calibrecontrol @CalibrePaul once again. 
Thank you for your support. https://t.co/8ptRG9cj2f

🔵⚪️ v 🔴🔴

Sandbach United v Stafford Town

The Bach get 3 points with a battling performance against a resilient Stafford Town team thanks to a thundering bobbler  from Tatters in the first half, a clean sheet and 3 points, it’s a happy Saturday night for The Bach! 

FT 1 0
